archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & EDITORIAL WARMTH (Agency / Nightlife / Culture)
design_intent: Warm editorial creative agency aesthetic for 'nocap.' — featuring warm cream/linen canvas, high-contrast crisp typography (condensed display + italicized serif accents), lush nightlife & cocktail lifestyle photography, interactive horizontal accordion services slider, real-time replaceable brand logo wall with 12+ brand slots, dynamic interactive client lead split showcase with 5 verifiable case studies, dual data story blocks, interactive proposal inquiry modal, and tactile micro-animations.

rules.headings_pairing: Mix uppercase condensed tracking-tighter with italic serif flourishes (e.g. 'WE DON'T SELL PACKAGES.' in bold grotesque + 'we solve problems.' in italicized Lora serif).

entry_surfaces./: Warm editorial agency hero — top photo carousel cards with opening hook headline 'CULTURE ARCHITECTS & BRAND CATALYSTS', pill CTA, live brand marquee, and split client showcase

visual_enhancers.border_radii: rounded-3xl (24px) for hero and case cards, rounded-full for pills and tags, rounded-2xl for stat blocks
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper noise background filter, soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)])
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) in light mode; 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) on dark panels
visual_enhancers.marquee: Continuous smooth marquee for client logo wall with logo upload/customization toolbar

sections_breakdown.name: Navigation Bar
sections_breakdown.description: Sticky pill/floating navbar with crystal glass effect (bg-[#FBF8F2]/90 backdrop-blur-md), logo 'nocap.', navigation anchor links (Work, Clients, Impact, Services, Story), 'Book a Discovery Call' CTA button with green dot pulse.

sections_breakdown.name: Opening Hook & Photo Carousel (Reference 1)
sections_breakdown.description: Hook headline: 'CULTURE-FIRST AGENCY // CRAFTING NO-BS REVENUE EXPERIENCES'. Hero carousel of 5 rounded-3xl photo cards with navigation arrows, category tags, interactive dragging/autoplay, and side-by-side 'WE DON'T SELL PACKAGES. WE SOLVE PROBLEMS.' card with 'OUR STORY' dark block.

sections_breakdown.name: Replaceable Brand Logo Wall (10-15 Slots)
sections_breakdown.description: Marquee / grid of 14 iconic brands: Conan Beer, Taj Hotels, Westin, Tinder, Simba, Stoli Vodka, Nicobar Gin, Tito's Handmade Vodka, Greater Than, Kati Patang, Casa Claro, Pistola Agave, Catwalk Botanics, Monkey Shoulder. Features an interactive 'Replace / Manage Logos' live modal so users can test uploading or changing client logos.

sections_breakdown.name: Our Clients in the Lead (Reference 2)
sections_breakdown.description: Split screen layout: Left sticky column with 'OUR CLIENTS IN THE LEAD' large display heading, copy, and lime accent button ('Explore Full Portfolio'). Right column features 5 high-impact client outcome cards with oversized metrics (+750%, 95K+, +30M, 400K+, 4.8x), badge tags, outcome descriptions, and preview photo.

sections_breakdown.name: 4-Column Stats Strip (Reference 3)
sections_breakdown.description: Clean 4-column metrics block with warm dividers: [ $74M+ Generated Revenue | 95% Retention Rate | +225 Campaigns Delivered | 92% Viral Conversion ] with subtle count-up animation.

sections_breakdown.name: Numbers Mean More When They Tell A Story (Reference 4)
sections_breakdown.description: Editorial grid layout with statement headline 'Numbers mean more when they tell a story.' and 6 structured narrative stat cards (Creator Network, Audience Footprint, Average ROAS, Organic Lift, Production Speed, Global Reach).

sections_breakdown.name: Our Expertise Accordion Slider (Reference 5)
sections_breakdown.description: Interactive horizontal accordion slider containing 7 core services: 1. Social Media Management, 2. Influencer Marketing, 3. Video & Graphic Editing, 4. Meta & ChatGPT Ads, 5. Brand Integration, 6. Sourcing & Production, 7. Event Management. Click or hover expands active panel showing high-res image, tag pills, deliverable list, and quote CTA, while collapsing others into sleek vertical typography ribbons.

sections_breakdown.name: Dark Kinetic Close & Interactive Brief Modal
sections_breakdown.description: Bold black section with oversized typography 'READY TO STOP PLAYING SMALL?' and an interactive instant project estimation/inquiry drawer with budget selector, deliverables checklist, and instant confirmation toast.

sections_breakdown.name: Editorial Footer
sections_breakdown.description: Deep obsidian/forest footer with oversized 'nocap.' brand typography, newsletter subscription, quick links, office hubs (Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Dubai), and copyright notice.

patterns.stagger_fade_in: Cards stagger in on scroll with y: 24 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, ease [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]
patterns.accordion_expand: layout transition on spring { stiffness: 300, damping: 30 } for smooth panel expansion
patterns.carousel_slide: Smooth drag or arrow clicks with index pagination and auto-advance toggle
patterns.hover_cards: Subtle scale-102 and shadow lift on client case cards

accessibility_requirements.min_contrast: 4.5:1 text to surface ratio strictly enforced across light and dark cards
accessibility_requirements.keyboard_nav: Full arrow key support on accordion and carousel with visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#143D2B])
accessibility_requirements.reduced_motion: All motion transitions disable automatically when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is detected

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default App.tsx / Home.tsx with the complete, highly polished 'nocap.' creative agency landing page matching the 5 user reference screenshots.
2. Fonts: Use @fontsource-variable/lora for editorial serif headings and @fontsource-variable/dm-sans for clean modern body text. Import them in src/index.css.
3. Hero Slider: Build a responsive carousel with smooth transitions, autoplay toggle, prev/next arrows, and the iconic 'WE DON'T SELL PACKAGES' story block beside it.

4. Brand Wall: Provide 12-15 brand logo tiles (Conan, Taj, Westin, Tinder, Simba, Stoli, Nicobar Gin, Tito's, Greater Than, Kati Patang, Casa Claro, Pistola, Catwalk Botanics) with a live 'Edit / Replace Logos' dialog so users can customize them.
5. Clients in Lead: Build the exact split layout with left sticky header and right stacked cards showing +750%, 95K+, +30M, 400K+, 4.8x with tags and thumbnail visuals.
6. Dual Stats Sections: Include both the 4-column metric strip ($74M, 95%, +225, 92%) and the 6-item 'Numbers mean more when they tell a story' editorial grid.

7. Services Accordion Slider: Replicate the 5th reference image — a horizontal accordion slider with 7 services (Social Media, Influencers, Video/Graphic Editing, Meta/ChatGPT Ads, Brand Integration, Sourcing, Event Management). The active panel expands to show image + description + tags, collapsed panels show rotated vertical titles.
8. Interactive Contact / Brief Drawer: Add a functional 'Start a Project' modal with budget sliders, service toggles, date selector, and Sonner toast feedback.
9. Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
